hydra_schema.notes: Eth2 is the PC's 2nd (internal) network port IP address. Eth2 is used as Service access port and for printer interna device communication (ST10, STF06, z stage, etc)

hydra_schema.description: Exhaust fan on hours. Not impacting machine performance - just a refererence how long/old the machine was up based on fan runtime data.

hydra_schema.notes:
Light tower colors/status. This is described in 3D Systems user guide.

examples: ALL_OFF, RED_SOLID, YELLOW_SOLID, GREEN_SOLID, RED_FLASHING, YELLOW_FLASHING, GREEN_FLASHING, RED_FLASHING_GREEN_SOLID, YELLOW_FLASHING_GREEN_SOLID, YELLOW_FLASHING_GREEN_FLASHING, IDENTIFY, RED_PULSE, YELLOW_PULSE, GREEN_PULSE, RED_GREEN_SOLID, YELLOW_GREEN_SOLID

HIGH = Door Closed
Low = Door Open

HIGH = bypass active
LOW= not in bypass
hydra_schema.description:
FW Bypass mode.
When FW_Pypass is enabled then that allows us to bypass some of the safety circuits tied to door open. So say when we Pause then we want to enable FW_Bypass to allow user to open the door without killing power to everything under the sun.

hydra_schema.notes: Eth1 is the customer network port IP address. External

hydra_schema.description:
Printer serial number. This value is programmed in the printer board and also printed on the dataplate (located on the back of the printer)

Each printer s/n is unique

hydra_schema.notes:
PUMP timeout error status "Normal" or "Failed"
Normal means no error.
Failed means pump error in material delivery.

HIGH = Print Platform present
LOW = Print Platform absent

LOW = Tray present
HIGH = Tray absent
